verdict.rationale: Amplitude is core analytics product with explicit retention/behavioral-cohort features: funnels/segmentation ('Build funnels, segment users, answer why'), user cohort creation, and cohort management APIs (list/export/upload). This directly supports retention-over-time analysis sliced by behavioral cohorts, which is a first-class Amplitude use case. Missing for 10: no explicit named 'Retention chart' documentation excerpt and no independent/hands-on report specifically confirming retention-by-cohort workflow quality.
